title: Wizard multi-tile target question mismatch: mixed LAN+Web asks 'What is the target network?' but URL input gives wrong interpretation
goal: When a user selects Internal LAN + External Web (multi-tile), the step 2 target question asks 'What is the target network?' — this is LAN-biased language. If the operator then types a URL (e.g. https://testphp.vulnweb.com), the interpretation shows 'CIDR range target for Internal LAN + External Web' even though a URL is not a CIDR. Fix: (1) For single-tile selections, keep the current tile-specific question ('What is the target website or app?' for web, 'What is the target network?' for LAN). (2) For multi-tile selections, use a generic question: 'What are the targets?' with a generic placeholder: 'e.g. https://app.example.com or 192.168.1.0/24'. (3) The interpretation logic must also handle the case where a URL is entered for a LAN+Web combination — show 'URL target added for External Web component' instead of incorrectly calling it a CIDR. (4) The quick-fill chips should also adapt: for multi-tile, show both URL and CIDR examples.
scope: Visual audit 2026-05-03: screenshot 03-wizard-s2-scope-filled-depth.png shows 'What is the target network?' for Internal LAN + External Web selection, and 'Predicted interpretation: CIDR range target for Internal LAN + External Web.' when a URL was entered. URL is not a CIDR — the interpretation is factually wrong.
